mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market weakness that may precede a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and HOUST does not produce negative returns in more than 50% of instances where both series decline by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (the 2017 base) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong housing activity signals robust consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1300.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 700,000 million dollars signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS < 700000.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
